en: Fixed `claude agents` ignoring `--permission-mode`, `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, `--model`, `--effort` or `--agent` typed before `agents` when a flag such as `--verbose` was also on the line
zh: 修复了 `claude agents` 忽略在 `agents` 之前输入的 `--permission-mode`、`--dangerously-skip-permissions`、`--model`、`--effort` 或 `--agent` 的问题：当命令行中同时带有 `--verbose` 等标志时会出现该问题
